# Keep separate answer and opportunity drafts available across view changes

## What & Why
Recovery currently helps when a user stays on the same list, but switching between Answer library and Applications can unmount the page and discard its temporary recovery state. Preserving one draft per entry type would protect users who move between views before returning to finish their work.

## Done looks like
- Dismissing an answer draft, switching to Applications, and returning still offers the answer draft.
- The same works independently for an opportunity draft.
- Recovering one draft does not replace or overwrite the other.

- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
